messages:
alex: quick ping — PR #2481 (serve: small refactor + formatting) is ready for merge but CI flagged a gofumpt diff. I pushed a tiny formatting fix, but there was also one naming nit in pkg/kv/serializer.go. can someone eyeball? link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2481

maria: on it, give me 10m

sam: noted — if the rename is just a local var (ctx -> ctxl) i'd prefer we do it here instead of a separate PR to avoid churn

alex: yeah it's a local var used in two funcs in the same file. i can include the rename in this branch, should be tiny. mixing in the fix to avoid another CI cycle

ci-bot: build/ci status: failed — gofumpt formatting mismatch in pkg/serve/handler.go. run `gofumpt -w .` and re-run tests.

alex: running `make lint` locally now, will push a follow-up commit with rename + fmt fix

alex: pushed: removed unused import, applied gofumpt, renamed ctx->ctxl in serializer.go. commit 3a8f2d2. running CI

tia: quick glance — changes look mechanical. the ctxl name is slightly awkward but fine. i'd ask for a short comment above the renamed var that explains it's an alias used to avoid shadowing in the closure

alex: good call, adding comment now 

sam: also there was a small linter warning about an exported const not being used in tests — fixed in your branch?

alex: i removed the unused const; that was leftover from the earlier refactor. i kept the log message change separate in the commit message

ci-bot: build/ci passed on branch 1719003456-refactor-format. all checks green ✅

maria: ran a quick review — LGTM modulo tia's comment. thanks for squashing the fmt and the rename into one tidy commit.

sam: i'm +1, will approve and merge in 3m to avoid stepping on the release window

release-bot: merge window open until 18:00 PT. If you're merging, ensure changelog entry is present for minor public API tweak.

alex: added a single-line changelog note in CHANGES.md: "pkg/kv: internal serializer var rename; formatting" — good enough?

tia: yep fine. tiny nit but safe to include in release notes.

sam: approving now. merging in 30s — will squash commits to keep history clean.

sam: merged PR #2481 — :shipit: 

maria: awesome, thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks all! i'll watch the rollout and open a follow-up if anything pops up

ci-bot: deploy triggered for canary-1 cluster

release-bot: note: if any downstream clients rely on the old var name (unlikely since it was internal) file an incident.

alex: noted. closing thread.
